name: MeterExchangeCampaignManager
tagline: Run the AMI meter exchange wave – book against crew capacity, beat no-access, and hand only plausible final reads to billing.
description: A complete smart meter exchange campaign app for electric, gas and water utilities in one PCF code component: capacity-aware appointment booking with life support notice, drag-and-drop calendar, exchange entry with photo evidence and instant read checks, no-access visits with automatic referral, old / new read reconciliation against the last billed read and expected use (rollover, negative, high / low use, start read, duplicate meter, AMI comms) and installer productivity with run sheets. Canvas apps, model-driven apps and a Power Pages installer portal.
features: Capacity-aware booking by installer and slot
Exchange entry with photo evidence and live read checks
No-access tracking with automatic referral after max attempts
Read reconciliation: rollover, negative, high / low use, start read, duplicate meter
AMI communication check with grace days
Bulk book, assign, refer and reconcile
Installer productivity, first-time access and run sheets
Undo, CSV / run sheet / reconciliation / summary JSON outputs
controlType: standard (MeterExchangeCampaignManager data-set + MeterExchangeCampaignManagerPortal field control, shared src/app)
